description: Sequencer of four concentric rings of notes read as four eight-step lines, with jump points between the lines and rotations that shift the notes

params.text: Rotates the notes of that ring: at 1 or -1 the ring turns one step each time the playhead finishes a line, positive turning it clockwise and negative counterclockwise
Attenuates and inverts that ring's cycle CV before it is added to the cycle setting
Sets the length of that line; above 8 the line ping-pongs, repeating the note at each end
Attenuates and inverts that line's length CV before it is added to the line's length
Sets how often a note on that line is silenced; while a note is silent the gate output stays low and the CV output holds its previous value
Attenuates and inverts that line's mute CV before it is added to the mute setting
Sets how often a note on that line plays several times in quick succession; how many are played comes from the ratchet speed on the menu
Attenuates and inverts that line's ratchet CV before it is added to the ratchet setting
Sets how far the playhead moves at that jump point once a line has been played through; at 1.3 it jumps two steps three times in ten and one step the rest of the time
Clicking steps that note through the chosen scale; right-clicking opens a menu for setting any note, randomizing, and changing the scale or root
Attenuates and inverts that jump CV before it is added to the jump setting

inputs.text: Raises or lowers that ring's cycle setting through its attenuverter
A rising edge turns that ring one step to the left, whatever its cycle setting is
A rising edge turns that ring one step to the right, whatever its cycle setting is
Raises or lowers that line's length through its attenuverter
Raises or lowers that line's mute setting through its attenuverter
Raises or lowers that line's ratchet setting through its attenuverter
Advances the sequence one step on each rising edge
Returns the sequence to its first step and returns every setting to the state last chosen by hand
Raises or lowers that jump setting through its attenuverter

outputs.text: Carries a gate whenever that ring turns, in either direction and from either its cycle setting or its triggers
Carries the gate of the note being played
Carries the pitch of the note being played, and holds its last value while a note is muted
Carries a gate on the first step after the sequence reaches its end
Carries a gate while the sequence is ratcheting
Carries a gate while a note is muted

notes: A jump point fires only when the playhead is travelling in its direction, so a jump setting of 0 can leave the playhead on one line
Bypassing this module connects the clock input to the gate output
The sequence moves only on a rising edge at the clock input, so with nothing patched there the module holds its first note
menu: Set Scale — picks the scale the notes come from and randomizes every note on the module
Root Note — changes the root and shifts every entered note by the interval between the old root and the new one
Range — sets how many octaves the notes span, centred on the fifth above the root
Ratchet Speed — sets how fast a ratchet plays: whole notes match the clock, half notes twice per clock, quarter notes four times
Randomize Notes — randomizes every note within the chosen scale, or shifts some of the notes an octave up or down
Active Cursor Color — picks the colour of the ring that marks the note being played
Add Expander — creates the play head expander, which adds three more playheads, or the randomizer expander, which adds buttons and triggers that randomize notes; each goes to the right
